question: maintainer review 2026-11-01, section 7: are the tool-calling sources in C1's training pack (Thinking-2507's original D4-Augmented pack, E1 part) licensed for C1's use -- training a 596M student by distillation in a research repository, no release authorized?

pack.e1_part: sequences 0-1943 (E1's own pack artifacts/shared/instruments/ladder_uniform_probe, blocks 6f324cb0...), all 1,944 inside C1's rung of 2,468 sequences; e1_validation = the 16 validation sequences

corpus.turn_expansion: one example per assistant turn; context = the conversation prefix (the source's own earlier turns, tool schemas and function responses); only the newly generated teacher turn is supervised

lineage_of_the_rows.row_ids: stage2 ids are the upstream row index (build_stage2_v0.build_glaive / build_stage2_v1.build_xlam: enumerate(rows))

targets_teacher.note: every supervised token is this teacher's generation; the upstream rows enter as prompt context only (user queries, tool schemas, the source's earlier assistant turns and function responses). The question is the PROMPT sources' terms: their rows are still training inputs of C1.

method: exact: per session of the pack's audit.jsonl with data_type tool_calling, grouped by the session-id prefix (glaive-/xlam-); supervised tokens = supervised_retained (no tool-calling turn is truncated, supervised_discarded 0); examples = distinct conversation ids before '#'; turns = sessions. The training sum 482,892 + 9,695 = 492,587 equals c1_identity_audit.json's figure.

sources.upstream_license: apache-2.0 (dataset card metadata at the recorded revision; README sha256 39c78f1f56b86fcd159cadeb8feda8a9333db6ef5ca0ce6830731ac3c666838e)
sources.upstream_terms_quote: the card at the recorded revision is metadata only: 'license: apache-2.0' -- no description of how the rows were generated, by which models, or under which terms (the hub page today: README content is empty)
sources.repo_marking: configs/stages/stage-2/reasoning_data/sources.json :: tool_calling -- 'glaive: Apache-2.0, provenance undocumented', role evaluation_only, approved_for_h1 false; token_matched_design.json :: categories tool_calling -- 'no legal training source: ... glaive's provenance is undocumented'
sources.why: the license tag is permissive and covers training use as such, but the rows are synthetic multi-turn conversations whose generator (model and its terms) is undocumented, so whether upstream model terms restrict training on them cannot be established; the repo itself classifies this source as having no legal training source for the v2 arms

sources.recorded_license: CC-BY-4.0 (auto-gated, accepted on the AlphaAvatar HF account) (stage2_offline_v1 manifest)
sources.upstream_license: cc-by-4.0, gated: 'Acknowledge to follow corresponding license and cite APIGen to access the repository' (card at the recorded revision; README sha256 8564c08b4555289ef4bb488f876ea4d7505d18e9f09edd9ec7869e6d0bbe523f)
sources.upstream_terms_quote: 'This release is for research purposes only in support of an academic paper.' and 'The first 33,659 data entries were generated by DeepSeek, i.e., from id 0 to id 33658.' Every C1 row is upstream id 0-116, so every one is DeepSeek-V2-Chat-generated. DeepSeek License Agreement v1.0 counts as a Derivative any model created by 'methods based on the generation of synthetic data by the Model for training the other model', and requires its Attachment A use-based restrictions to be passed on to users of a Derivative (paragraphs 4(a), 5)
sources.repo_marking: configs/stages/stage-2/reasoning_data/sources.json :: tool_calling -- "CC-BY-4.0 but gated, 'for research purposes only', rows generated by DeepSeek-V2-Chat (whose license counts distilled models as derivatives)"; historical_corpus_flags.corpus_v2 -- 'xLAM rows are research-only and DeepSeek-V2-generated'; data/eval-set/eval-set-1/NOTICE.md -- the 7 xlam eval prompts are kept outside the public core 'until [the redistribution terms] are' confirmed (maintainer 2026-10-19)
sources.why: C1 is internal research training with no release, which the 'research purposes only' statement and CC-BY-4.0 (attribution) admit; but the gate's access agreement has not been reviewed in the repo, and the rows are DeepSeek-V2 output, so under the DeepSeek License a student trained on them is arguably a Derivative carrying Attachment A's use-based restrictions -- binding on any later distribution or deployment of C1's checkpoints

restricted_sources.open_question: is an Apache-2.0 tag with undocumented generation provenance an adequate basis for C1's training use?
accept research-only use under the gate's agreement, and the DeepSeek License's derivative restrictions on any later distribution of C1's checkpoints?

consequence: C1 cannot be launched on the claim that its whole pack's sources are proven licensed for training: 492,587 of its 5,923,021 supervised tokens (8.3%; 16.6% of the E1 part) come from these two sources. Removing them would no longer be D4-Augmented's pack (and a re-pack changes E1's ladder), so neither launching nor removing is done here: the maintainer rules.
not_in_scope: the E1 part's other model-generated prompt sources (e.g. magicoder_oss, 41 turns / 103,683 supervised tokens of code; openmath_instruct_2, Llama-generated) were not audited here
observed_in_passing: one glaive conversation (glaive-000941) has turns in both the training part and the 16 validation sequences (1,421 training + 13 validation conversations, 1,433 distinct): a turn-level, not conversation-level, train/validation split in E1's pack; recorded, not repaired (C1's pack is unchanged)
